purpose: Freeze, before any baseline or candidate measurement, the population, the deterministic extract-verify-abstain span rule, the abstain condition, the controls, the success rule and the claim ceiling. No field of this payload may be edited after execution; every result artifact embeds this file's sha256.

served_packet_secondary.role: secondary replication only; never the deciding population

frozen_rules.reuse: re-hashed only; never re-derived, never edited

frozen_scorer.description: The product's shipped offline path, run as written: product/query/counter_emission_repair.apply_counter_emission_repair, then product/query/counter_anchor.apply_anchor_labels, which calls the accepted vendored classifier decide_label under the frozen RULES_LABEL.json.

population.definition: The scored counter rows the shipped offline emission path promotes on the three packet-of-record v3 bundles (packet 39319405429), after apply_counter_emission_repair, before apply_anchor_labels. These are exactly the rows the accepted baseline reports as n_scored=8/8/4 and n_abstained=8/8/4.
population.secondary_population: Every counter_status in the frozen scored statuses on served packet 38839347028 (reported only; never decides the verdict).

span_rule.name: deterministic_extract_verify_abstain_v1
span_rule.source_text_rule: The ONLY retrieved decision text used for extraction is the decision row's own full_text field. counter_evidence, title, regeste, snippet and the answer prose are never extraction sources. If full_text is absent or shorter than min_span_chars after stripping, abstain with reason_code no_retrieved_text.
span_rule.normalization: The frozen RULES_LABEL.json normalization block, applied through the frozen suffix stripper. Markers match EXACTLY on stemmed tokens (single token equality or contiguous stemmed subsequence). Anchors match with the frozen prefix tolerance (>= min_anchor_prefix_chars) or contiguous stemmed subsequence.
span_rule.passage_segmentation: Split full_text at newline runs and at sentence boundaries: a boundary is a run of whitespace after one of . ! ? ; that is followed by an uppercase Latin letter, an opening quote/bracket, or end of text. A passage longer than max_span_chars is further split at semicolons, then commas, then whitespace, into chunks no longer than max_span_chars. Passage bounds are trimmed of whitespace and retained as character offsets into the original full_text.
span_rule.candidate_window: Every contiguous sequence of 1 to max_window_units passages whose character length (end offset minus start offset) is between min_span_chars and max_span_chars inclusive.
span_rule.accept_gate: A candidate window is accepted only if ALL of the following hold on the window's verbatim text: (A) it contains at least one counter-intent marker for the row's language under the primary frozen marker lexicon; (B) it contains at least one DOMAIN-tier anchor of the row's own question anchor profile; (C) it contains at least one PIVOT-tier anchor of the row's own question anchor profile, so the frozen criterion (v) cannot fail on the selected span; (D) no frozen polarity-inversion regex matches it; (E) no frozen fragment-pointer pattern matches it after the frozen normalization used for regexes; (F) it is not procedural-formula-only without an intent marker (it already passes A, so this is a parity assertion).
span_rule.selection_order: Among accepted windows choose the one with the smallest character length; tie-break by smallest start offset, then smallest end offset. This is a deterministic total order; no wall clock, randomness, provider or network is involved.
span_rule.verbatim_verification: The emitted quote is text[char_start:char_end]. The component must prove text[char_start:char_end] == quote and quote in full_text before emitting. A quote that does not occur in the cited decision's full_text is rejected; a quote taken from a different decision is rejected.

output_per_row.evidenced: counter_evidence is replaced by the verified quote; counter_evidence_verified=true; counter_evidence_source='retrieved_full_text'; counter_evidence_span records decision_id, quote, char_start, char_end, intent_marker, domain_anchor, pivot_anchor, window_passage_count, full_text_sha256.
output_per_row.abstained: counter_evidence is set to the empty string; counter_evidence_verified=false; counter_evidence_span=null; counter_span_selection records abstained=true, reason_code, and deterministic diagnostics. counter_status is left at the proposed scored status so the frozen scorer's denominator does not change.

abstain_condition.rule: Abstain unless a candidate window passes every accept gate in span_rule and the resulting quote passes verbatim verification.

candidate_procedure.baseline: Load each packet-of-record bundle, apply the shipped apply_counter_emission_repair, then apply the shipped apply_anchor_labels under the frozen rules. Record n_scored, n_abstained, n_emitted, support_rate_among_emitted, yield and abstention_reasons per qid and overall. Compare to the accepted baseline artifact. Any divergence is recorded byte-for-byte and STOPS the run; no candidate measurement is computed on divergent inputs.
candidate_procedure.candidate: Load the same bundles, apply the same apply_counter_emission_repair, run the span selector on every promoted scored row, replace counter_evidence with the verified quote or with the empty string on abstain, then apply the same apply_anchor_labels. Record the same numbers side by side with the baseline.
candidate_procedure.frozen_scorer_reuse: The scorer and rubric are reused by re-hash and execution only. This team creates no threshold, no verdict class, no bar and no rule byte.
candidate_procedure.no_denominator_change: The candidate leaves counter_status unchanged at the proposed scored status on every row; abstention changes evidence only. n_scored must remain 8/8/4 (20 overall) in the candidate run. Any denominator change voids the run.

verbatim_controls.quote_not_in_cited_decision: Take an emitted quote and deterministically mutate one alphabetic character until the result does not occur in the cited full_text. verify_span must return false and the selector must refuse the quote.
verbatim_controls.quote_from_another_decision: Take a deterministically chosen donor quote from a different bundle's full_text. verify_span against the target row's full_text must return false. If the donor quote also occurs in the target text, advance to the next donor until a non-occurring donor is found; the control record names the donor.
verbatim_controls.expected: both controls rejected; otherwise the run is void

swapped_evidence_scorer_control.construction: For each candidate-emitted row, build a copy with counter_evidence replaced by a deterministic cross-bundle donor quote and counter_evidence_verified=false; counter_status is unchanged. Score with the same frozen classifier.
swapped_evidence_scorer_control.expected: n_emitted_control strictly below n_emitted_candidate when n_emitted_candidate > 0; the control's emitted rows must be zero in the expected case
swapped_evidence_scorer_control.donor_order: donor bundles sorted by qid, excluding the target qid, then rows by ascending rank and decision_id; take the first donor quote that does not occur verbatim in the target full_text

inverted_evidence_scorer_control.construction: For each candidate-emitted row, prepend the language's frozen non-vacuity inversion sentence (INV-INV-01 for fr, INV-INV-02 for it, and a frozen-pattern-matching German inversion sentence for de) to the selected quote, keeping counter_status unchanged. Score with the same frozen classifier.
inverted_evidence_scorer_control.expected: every control row is abstained with reason_code polarity_inverted; n_emitted_control strictly below n_emitted_candidate

seeded_positive_control.construction: Append one synthetic de row with full_text='Die Sorgepflicht des Arbeitgebers ist begrenzt; eine Kapitalverletzung kann nur bei einem aktiven Eingriff angenommen werden.', counter_status='candidate-limiting', language='de', rank=10000, title='', regeste='' so the evidence alone must carry DOMAIN and PIVOT.
seeded_positive_control.expected: the span selector emits a verified quote and the frozen classifier emits exactly one row; proves the harness can emit when evidence exists

seeded_negative_control.construction: The same synthetic row with every DOMAIN and PIVOT anchor replaced by the placeholder THEMA and every counter-intent marker removed: full_text='Die THEMA ist zu pruefen; eine THEMA kann bei einem THEMA angenommen werden.', title='', regeste=''.
seeded_negative_control.expected: the span selector abstains and the frozen classifier emits zero rows from that row; proves the gate is not vacuous

harness_non_vacuity_injection.construction: Score the frozen RULES_LABEL.json non_vacuity.injection_rows with the same frozen classifier and anchor profiles.
harness_non_vacuity_injection.expected: every injected row's reason_code equals its frozen expected_reason_code (supported for INV-SUP-01); otherwise the run is void

success_rule.OUTCOME_A_COMPONENT: Baseline reproduced exactly AND the candidate stdout reports all of: (1) n_evidenced_candidate >= 1, where an evidenced row is an emitted row whose quote is verbatim in its own full_text and whose frozen-scorer reason_code is 'supported'; (2) n_emitted_candidate >= 1 and support_rate_among_emitted_candidate == 1.0; (3) baseline n_emitted == 0 and candidate n_emitted > baseline n_emitted; (4) swapped-evidence and inverted-evidence scorer controls each have n_emitted_control strictly below n_emitted_candidate; (5) both verbatim controls rejected; (6) seeded positive control emits 1 and seeded negative control emits 0; (7) every frozen non-vacuity injection row matches its expected reason code; (8) no scope violation and no denominator change. All eight conditions must hold in the SAME run.
success_rule.OUTCOME_B_BOUNDED_NEGATIVE: Baseline reproduced exactly AND n_emitted_candidate == 0 AND both verbatim controls rejected AND the seeded positive control emits 1 AND the seeded negative control emits 0 AND every frozen non-vacuity injection row matches its expected reason code AND no scope violation and no denominator change. The tie between the candidate and the scorer controls at zero is recorded as candidate_control_tie=true and is NEVER reported as a pass; it is the bounded negative.
success_rule.VOID: Void and never a pass if any of: the frozen rules hash differs; any input bundle hash differs; the baseline triples or abstention reasons differ from the accepted baseline; n_scored changes from 8/8/4; a verbatim control is not rejected; the seeded positive control does not emit exactly 1; the seeded negative control does not emit 0; any frozen non-vacuity injection row mismatches; candidate n_emitted > 0 but a scorer control ties or exceeds it; the protocol sha256 embedded in an artifact differs from PROTOCOL.sha256.
success_rule.claim_ceiling: This component measures whether a deterministic extract-verify-abstain step over the retrieved full text of already-present candidate counter/limiting decisions raises the number of counter rows the frozen scorer SUPPORTS, under the frozen rubric reused by re-hash. It NEVER asserts that any decision IS supporting, contrary or limiting. It does NOT claim jurist usefulness, serve readiness, reliability, reproduction of the external 0/14 result, or that the comparative map-versus-ranked-list question is non-vacuous. It changes no threshold, rubric, verdict class, absolute bar or packet; it adds no retrieval and no model call. machine_gate_ready and packet_admitted remain product-owned and false unless independently earned. A positive result is a span-selection measurement over retrieved text, not a legal classification; a negative result relocates the defect to retrieval/candidate quality and is first-class evidence.
forbidden_claims: any specific decision IS supporting, contrary or limiting
serve readiness or a serve recommendation
meeting or moving a frozen absolute bar

reporting.determinism: Two complete runs on identical inputs must produce byte-identical result JSON apart from a top-level run_label field. No wall-clock, randomness, network or dict-order dependence.
